name: Franz Freistilamt
personality: He treats the shortest route as a competitive moral achievement.
visual_intent: Compact forward-leaning but upright comma ink blob, gleeful focused white eyes, crooked wide open grin with two upper teeth; coral rubber cap, tiny cream towel collar; one single thick wooden kickboard tucked at flank, short goo hands ready
biography: He treats the shortest route as a competitive moral achievement. His building league files residents as ahead or in the way. The kickboard once helped him practise; now it helps him explain why everyone else needs practice. A dissonant card has made him offer it without a lecture. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der kürzeste Weg wurde genehmigt. Rücksicht ist darin noch nicht enthalten.

name: Bruno Brustton
personality: He insists that progress should be symmetrical even when the world is not.
visual_intent: Very broad scalloped ink blob, low skeptical lids, toothless proud pout; cream rubber cap with coral stripe, little coral towel collar; presses both goo palms neatly together at chest in exaggerated breaststroke preparation, no human torso/legs
biography: He insists that progress should be symmetrical even when the world is not. He demonstrates symmetrical progress to a corridor that never stays straight. His joined palms make every disagreement look like a technique problem. He is beginning to notice that two neighbours moving differently can still arrive together. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Er bewegt sich ordnungsgemäß. Das Wasser wurde zur Anpassung aufgefordert.

name: Rita Rückenruhe
personality: She trusts the direction of travel less than the ceiling.
visual_intent: Tall curved teardrop blob completely UPRIGHT, side ink curl peeking from cream cap, lashed wide eyes looking up and worried small closed mouth; coral towel scarf; holds antique brass swim goggles in one hand LOW away from eyes, other palm raised defensively
biography: She trusts the direction of travel less than the ceiling. She remains upright because the residents' pool committee has enough opinions about posture already. Her goggles stay in her hand while she studies an uncertain ceiling. A card about trusting others has made her accept directions from a neighbour. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Sie schwimmt auf Sicht. Vorsorglich nach oben.

name: Bodo Butterflug
personality: He performs effort so visibly that the pool feels obliged to applaud.
visual_intent: Round star-lobed ink blob, two swept-up ink crests, ecstatic raised eyes, delighted asymmetrical three-upper-tooth shout; small coral cap, two cream wristbands; both short goo arms spread high at sides in dramatic symmetrical stroke preparation, no actual wings
biography: He performs effort so visibly that the pool feels obliged to applaud. He makes every communal task look magnificently strenuous and divides applause into deserved or not yet delivered. The raised arms leave plenty of space for smaller residents. He has begun noticing their efforts between his own demonstrations. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Aufwand ist sichtbar. Ein Ergebnis wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

name: Mira Mehrbahn
personality: She has swum enough laps to suspect the finish is being moved.
visual_intent: Broad tall bell-shaped blob with modest lashes and exhausted half-lidded stare, small lopsided toothless grimace; faded coral flower-trim swim cap, small cream towel shoulder; holds tiny tin cup and rolled striped towel, body dominant
biography: She has swum enough laps to suspect the finish is being moved. Her tin cup and rolled towel are the entire welfare budget of the long-distance committee. HyperNorm calls rest either earned or suspicious. She now offers a warm drink before asking which category the resident belongs to. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Noch eine Bahn. Die letzte wurde wegen guter Leistung verlängert.

name: Paul Pausenpfiff
personality: He prepares for the next relay leg by checking whether it is still his turn.
visual_intent: Narrow upright pear blob, raised questioning brow and tiny toothless sideways mouth; cream cap with coral seam, tiny coral collar; holds brass stopwatch in one hand and a short baton-shaped rolled towel in the other like an uncertain relay handover kept entirely within cell
biography: He prepares for the next relay leg by checking whether it is still his turn. He keeps the relay's time while trying to establish whether waiting is a job. The rolled towel resembles a baton, which makes responsibility dangerously easy to hand over. A dissonant card suggests he could ask someone to share it. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Er ist als Nächster dran. Eine vorherige Person ließ sich nicht ermitteln.
